desc:
🚲 BIKE FOR ANIMALS EGGS! 🥚

🌄 Ride across the wild, steal rare Eggs, and race back to your Pen!

💡 How to Play:

* 🚲 Ride to different regions and discover new Egg zones!
* 🥚 Steal an Egg and bring it back to your Pen!
* 🐊 Watch out for the Animals chasing you!
* 🪨 Dodge HUGE rolling boulders while carrying your Egg!
* 💥 Get hit by a boulder OR an Animal and you'll DROP your Egg!
* 🏃 Escape and get your Egg safely back home!
* 🐣 Hatch your Eggs to discover rare Pets!
* 💰 Earn Cash from your Pets!
* ⚡ Use the Bike Treadmill to become FASTER!
* 🏕️ Travel farther to discover better and rarer Eggs!

🚲 The farther you ride, the better the Eggs you can find!

🥚 Can you steal the rarest Eggs and make it home?

👍 Like the game and join the group for FREE rewards!

🎮 Supports PC, Mobile, and Tablet!
